error: HTTP 403 TOKEN_INVALID while the batch reused one 30-minute page token

evidence_retained.reason_structured_rows_missing: The first runner version only wrote result rows after the whole matrix completed.

root_cause: The experiment client treated 36 independent UI-equivalent operations as one browser token lifetime. The plugin's 30-minute CSRF-style page token expiry behaved as designed.
corrective_action: Refresh admission and administration page tokens before every independent scenario and checkpoint rows after each completed run.
